scope: isolated branch ritsu-os-v0 deterministic test execution only
trigger: No existing push workflow runs for ritsu-os-v0 after source commits.
evidence: GitHub actions runs query returned total_count=0 for branch ritsu-os-v0 event=push.

boundary.allowed: branch-only deterministic contract test with read-only repository permissions and no secrets
boundary.forbidden: deployment, production promotion, device/runtime acceptance, or treating GitHub Actions as proof of deployed Ritsu continuity

five_pass_review.target: Execute the exact new router contract remotely rather than laundering a local preflight as proof.
five_pass_review.antagonist: Prevent broad CI, secret use, deployment side effects, or a green workflow being mislabeled deployed/accepted.
five_pass_review.provenance: Workflow result may prove only the tested commit on GitHub-hosted Python; it cannot prove primary Latin wording or live chat routing.
five_pass_review.regression: Path filters and branch filter isolate the workflow from default branches and existing organs.
five_pass_review.compression: One stdlib-only job runs py_compile and the single Ritsu contract file.

safety_review.venice: prohibited by active manic-accessibility repository safety mode
